US and Greenland Sign Security Agreement

The United States and Greenland have signed a security agreement granting the U.S. permanent control over all security needs in Greenland. U.S. State Secretary Rubio described the pact as a 'huge win' that 'completely addresses' national security concerns. The agreement solidifies U.S. security presence and responsibilities on the island.
